newsitem.title: USA: Penn National files for 2.3 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Penn National files for 2.3 mln shares.

text.p: Penn National Gaming Inc said Friday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up 2.3 million common shares.

Of the total, 1,725,000 will be offered by the company and 575,000 will be sold be selling shareholders, the company said in the filing. After the offer, outstanding shares will total 15,080,290 common.

The underwriters have been granted a 30-day over-allotment option to buy up to 345,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Salomon Brothers, Gerard Klauer Mattison & Co Inc and Jefferies & Co Inc.
Net proceeds will be used to repay indebtedness incurred in connection with the Pocono Downs acquisition and to be incurred by the Charles Town acquisition, Penn said.
The balance of the proceeds will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes, Penn said.
Penn National Gaming Inc, of Wyomissing, Pa., operates a pari-mutuel wagering locations in Pennsylvania.
